Document chasing is the quiet cost in every accounting practice. Each reminder is small, but together they steal partner and senior hours.

An assistant can send reminders, track what has arrived and keep a deadline list. Tax advice and filings stay with your qualified team.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-for-accountants?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ac1-docs

Law firms can hand off intake admin, scheduling and billing preparation with strict limits: no legal advice, no handling of client funds, and clear confidentiality terms.

Start with one repeat task and keep the access narrow.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-for-law-firms?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=lf1-intake

If email is the first thing you open and the last thing you close, it is a hand-off candidate. Sorting, flagging and drafting routine replies follows rules you can write down in one page.

A free plan shows what to hand off first, week by week.
